title: Eternal Clarice Toilet Suite
descriptionHtml:
The Eternal Clarice is a back to wall toilet suite with a rimless bowl and a clean, boxy cistern. The seat sits at 475 mm, a little higher than a standard suite, which makes it easier to get up from without going to a full care height.

Use it for

  • Main bathrooms, ensuites and powder rooms
  • Replacing an older suite where the waste is 100 to 250 mm from the wall
  • Anyone who finds a standard 400 to 430 mm seat a bit low

Specifications

  • Model: DSA8080
  • Size: 645 x 385 x 860 mm
  • Seat height: 475 mm
  • Trap: S-trap 100 to 250 mm set-out, or P-trap 180 mm
  • Flush: rimless
  • Finish: white ceramic
  • Soft close seat included

Good to know

  • Rimless bowls have no hidden rim underneath, so there is nowhere for grime to build up.
  • Measure from the finished wall to the centre of the waste before ordering so the trap suits.
  • Installation by a licensed plumber.

title: Edna Care Toilet Suite
descriptionHtml:
The Edna Care is a care toilet suite: a longer 800 mm pan, a 470 mm seat height and a grey seat that stands out against the white bowl for people with low vision. It suits accessible bathrooms in homes, aged care and commercial buildings.

Use it for

  • Accessible and ambulant bathrooms
  • Home modifications for people with limited mobility
  • Aged care, clinics and community buildings

Specifications

  • Model: DSA8081
  • Size: 800 x 385 x 860 mm
  • Seat height: 470 mm
  • Trap: S-trap 115 to 200 mm set-out, or P-trap 180 mm
  • Flush: rimless
  • Finish: white ceramic, grey contrast seat

Good to know

  • The matching back rest (model DSA8081-Back rest) is sold separately.
  • The longer pan sits further from the wall, so check the room has space for grab rails and transfer.
  • Installation by a licensed plumber.

title: Edna Care Toilet Back Rest
descriptionHtml:
The back rest for the Edna Care toilet suite gives a padded support behind the user, which care and accessible bathroom designs usually call for. It mounts to the wall behind the suite.

Use it for

  • Completing an Edna Care suite in an accessible bathroom
  • Care homes, clinics and home modifications

Specifications

  • Model: DSA8081-Back rest
  • Fits: Edna Care Toilet Suite (DSA8081)
  • Padded rest on a steel frame, wall mounted

Good to know

  • Sold separately from the suite.
  • Fix into solid blocking or masonry so it takes a person's weight.

title: Eternal Element Toilet Suite
descriptionHtml:
The Eternal Element is a compact back to wall toilet suite with a rimless bowl. At 610 mm deep it is one of the shorter suites around, and the S-trap set-out starts at 55 mm, so it fits tight rooms and older plumbing where the waste is close to the wall.

Use it for

  • Small bathrooms, ensuites and powder rooms
  • Renovations where the waste sits close to the wall
  • Budget-conscious bathroom updates

Specifications

  • Model: DSA8084
  • Size: 610 x 385 x 815 mm
  • Seat height: 430 mm
  • Trap: S-trap 55 to 175 mm set-out, or P-trap 180 mm
  • Flush: rimless
  • Finish: white ceramic
  • Soft close seat included

Good to know

  • Rimless bowls are easier to keep clean because there is no rim for grime to hide under.
  • Measure from the finished wall to the centre of the waste before ordering.
  • Installation by a licensed plumber.

title: Caleb Aria Wall Faced Toilet with In-Wall Cistern
descriptionHtml:
The Caleb Aria is a wall faced floor pan that hides the cistern inside the wall, leaving only the pan and a flush plate on show. The rimless tornado flush washes the whole bowl with 3.4 litres on average, and the pan sits hard against the wall with no gap behind it to clean.

Use it for

  • New bathrooms and renovations where the wall is being opened up
  • Minimal, easy-clean bathrooms with a flat wall behind the toilet
  • Pairing with a wall hung vanity for a floating look

Specifications

  • Model: DSA8102
  • Pan size: 545 x 360 x 410 mm
  • Trap: S-trap, 100 to 125 mm set-out
  • Flush: rimless tornado, dual flush, WELS 4 Star: 4.5 L full / 3.1 L half / 3.4 L average
  • WaterMark certified to AS 1172.1 and AS 1172.2
  • Finish: white ceramic
  • Soft close seat included

What's in the box

  • Pan, seat and the matching in-wall cistern (DSA8102-CISTERN) with flush plate

Good to know

  • The cistern needs a framed wall cavity; plan it before the wall is lined and tiled.
  • Installation by a licensed plumber.

title: Eternal Edge Toilet Suite
descriptionHtml:
The Eternal Edge is a two-piece back to wall toilet suite with a rimless bowl and a dual flush that averages 3.4 litres. The cistern has square edges and a flat top, and the pan sits flush to the wall so there is no gap to clean behind.

Use it for

  • Main bathrooms, ensuites and powder rooms
  • Renovations: the S-trap set-out covers 70 to 250 mm with the optional pipe kit
  • Square-edged bathroom schemes

Specifications

  • Model: DSA8202
  • Size: 630 x 360 x 850 mm
  • Seat height: 415 mm
  • Trap: S-trap 70 to 150 mm set-out as supplied (140 mm recommended); 70 to 250 mm with additional pipes, sold separately
  • Flush: rimless, dual flush, WELS 4 Star: 4.5 L full / 3.1 L half / 3.4 L average

  • Finish: white ceramic
  • Soft close seat included

Good to know

title: Eternal Flow Toilet Suite
descriptionHtml:
The Eternal Flow is a two-piece back to wall toilet suite with a rimless tornado flush: water enters from one point and spins around the bowl, which cleans the whole surface quietly on 3.4 litres average. The pan is a touch shorter than the Edge and Forma at 605 mm.

Use it for

  • Main bathrooms, ensuites and powder rooms
  • Renovations with a waste anywhere from 60 to 220 mm off the wall, using the right pipe kit
  • Quieter flushing in bathrooms next to bedrooms

Specifications

  • Size: 605 x 360 x 840 mm
  • Seat height: 400 mm
  • Trap: S-trap 100 to 170 mm set-out as supplied (140 mm recommended); pipe A 60 to 125 mm, pipe B 100 to 170 mm, pipe C 150 to 220 mm, sold separately
  • Flush: rimless tornado, dual flush, WELS 4 Star: 4.5 L full / 3.1 L half / 3.4 L average
  • WaterMark certified to AS 1172.1 and AS 1172.2
  • Finish: white ceramic
  • Soft close seat included

Good to know

  • Measure from the finished wall to the centre of the waste and pick the pipe kit to suit.
  • Installation by a licensed plumber.

title: Caleb Vero Wall Hung Toilet with In-Wall Cistern
descriptionHtml:
The Caleb Vero is a wall hung toilet: the pan floats off the floor on a steel frame hidden in the wall, with the cistern behind the wall lining and only a flush plate showing. The floor runs clean underneath, and the rimless tornado flush uses 3.4 litres on average.

Use it for

  • New bathrooms and renovations where the wall is being framed and opened up
  • Easy-clean bathrooms with nothing on the floor
  • Matching a wall hung vanity

Specifications

  • Model: DSA8305
  • Pan size: 520 x 360 x 330 mm
  • Trap: P-trap, wall hung
  • Flush: rimless tornado, dual flush, WELS 4 Star: 4.5 L full / 3.1 L half / 3.4 L average
  • WaterMark certified to AS 1172.1 and AS 1172.2
  • Finish: white ceramic
  • Soft close seat included

What's in the box

  • Pan, seat and the in-wall body: steel frame, cistern and flush plate

Good to know

  • The frame needs a wall cavity about 1140 mm high and is fixed to the floor and wall; plan it before lining and tiling.
  • Pan height is set on the frame during installation, so it can be raised for easier use.
  • Installation by a licensed plumber.

title: Crystal Prime Smart Toilet Suite
descriptionHtml:
The Crystal Prime is a one-piece smart toilet with a built-in bidet seat, so washing, drying, flushing and the lid all work without touching anything. A foot sensor opens and closes the lid, the seat is heated, and a single touch runs wash, dry and flush in one go. The rimless tornado flush is WaterMark certified and uses 3.4 litres on average.

Features

  • Touch-free automatic lid, foot sensor for flushing
  • Rear wash, front wash and oscillating wash with adjustable water pressure and nozzle position
  • Nozzle self-cleans before and after each use
  • Heated seat: room temperature, 35, 37 or 39 °C
  • Wash water: room temperature, 34, 37 or 40 °C, heated instantly with no storage tank
  • Warm air drying: 35, 45 or 55 °C
  • Soft night light and LED temperature display
  • Handheld remote plus a side button for one-touch flushing
  • Automatic dual flush: half flush after a short visit, full flush after a longer one
  • Eight safety protections including seat temperature, leakage, water ingress, power failure and overheating

Specifications

  • Model: DSAG1FD-E
  • Size: 705 x 390 x 460 mm
  • Colour: white
  • Body: ceramic with ABS seat and lid
  • Trap: S-trap, set-out adjustable 60 to 280 mm
  • Flush: rimless tornado, dual flush, WELS 4 Star: 4.5 L full / 3.1 L half / 3.4 L average
  • WELS standard AS/NZS 6400, licence 1979
  • WaterMark certified to AS 1172.1 and AS 1172.2
  • Power: 220 to 240 V, 50 Hz, rated 1250 W
  • Splash protection: IPX4
  • Weight: about 45 kg

Good to know

  • Needs a power point beside the toilet and a cold water supply with a minimum of 0.07 MPa dynamic pressure.
  • Confirm the floor waste position and the S-trap set-out before installation.
  • Installation by a licensed plumber and electrician.
